task.description:
Produce test specs and test code for OIDC-11 through OIDC-15.

Read the requirements (docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md lines 1573-1660) and the design artefacts, then write:

1. Test spec files at tests/specs/OIDC-11.md, OIDC-12.md, OIDC-13.md, OIDC-14.md, OIDC-15.md
2. Test source code in the appropriate test files under tests/

DIRECTIVE T-1 (from CLAUDE.md): No mocks, no stubs, no in-memory fakes in any test file. All integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL.

DIRECTIVE T-2: No mocks, stubs, or HTTP-level mocking. Every test involving API data must be against real backend and real database.

Key test scenarios:
- OIDC-11: User renamed/remailed at provider retains same local user_id; lookup by (external_realm, sub) is authoritative; no fallback to email/username
- OIDC-12: Tenant creation with idp_realm_id; lookup by realm ID returns tenant; default tenant has idp_realm_id = 'bpm-default'
- OIDC-13: Tokens issued contain tenant_id claim; clients cannot override tenant_id
- OIDC-14: Creating a tenant provisions fully configured realm; realm immediately ready to issue tokens; tenant_id protocol mapper included
- OIDC-15: Mark for deletion then hard delete after grace period; marked realms refuse new logins; hard deletion is irreversible and audit-logged
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in each requirement maps to at least one test case
Test code compiles and fits the project's test conventions
No mocks, stubs, or in-memory fakes (per DIRECTIVE T-1 and T-2)
No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST requirement test

result.summary: Test specs and integration test code for OIDC-11 through OIDC-15. Five test spec files created at tests/specs/OIDC-11.md through OIDC-15.md. Five integration test files created under tests/integration/ covering all MUST acceptance criteria. Updated build.zig with module definitions for the 5 new OIDC modules and registered them in the test-integration step. Also fixed pre-existing compile issues: unused testing variable in identity_stability.zig, pointless discard in realm_deletion.zig. Verified zig build and zig build test exit 0 with no error-set issues.
